tools.name: api_index
tools.description: Discovers the whole PageAudit API (self-describing index).

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Lists the micro-tools (title, meta, canonical, OG, JSON-LD…).

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Copy and checks of one micro-tool by slug (e.g. title-tag-checker).

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Audits a URL and returns the full report with the ready fix for each finding (`fixes`), without a tab.

tools.name: create_guest
tools.description: Creates a guest token pa_… for the tab workspace.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: Lists the owner's tabs (guest or session).

tools.name: create_tab
tools.description: Opens a tab for a URL in the workspace.

tools.name: get_audit
tools.description: Re-reads an audit already made, with `fixes` (the ready fix for each finding).

tools.name: get_patch
tools.description: The consolidated patch of an audit: <head> block to paste, files to create and templates with placeholders. No model — only facts from the page.

tools.name: get_badge
tools.description: Metadata and markdown of the SVG badge of a shared report.

tools.name: billing
tools.description: Free plan, prices, x402 parameters and the trial offer: sign-up with a confirmed e-mail = 90 days without paywall (`trial` field; with a session it shows the state).

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Sends a support message or a sponsorship/partnership/advertising proposal. Agent: no captcha → 402 ($0.10 x402). Human: Turnstile. After the 1st agent message there is backoff: 429 + Retry-After (60s → 2×, 1h cap; resets in 24h).
